derivation: by simpa only [mem_unstableSet, Function.comp_def, hconj.semiconj] using e.isInducing.tendsto_nhds_iff (f := fun t : ℝ => φ t y) (l := atBot) (y := x)
explanation: The Mathlib lemma characterizes convergence to a point by convergence of the composed function under an inducing map. Apply it to the trajectory t ↦ φ t y; semiconjugacy identifies its composition with e and the target trajectory t ↦ ψ t (e y). The existing proof instead uses the library's IsInducing.map_mem_unstableSet_iff.
